title: US disputes Iran strike on Navy ship trying to enter Strait of Hormuz
text:
Iran claimed its forces struck a U.S. Navy unmanned surface vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday as the conflict escalates with renewed fighting.

U.S. Central Command denied the purported strike, accusing Iran of lying.
